name: Ondo InsurTech Plc
summary: Ondo InsurTech Plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides domestic leak detection services and technology in the United Kingdom, Nordics, and the United States. It offers LeakBot, a water leak claims prevention system; and engages in distribution activities. The company was formerly known as Spinnaker Acquisitions Plc and changed its name to Ondo InsurTech Plc in March 2022. Ondo InsurTech Plc was incorporated in 2021 and is based in London, the United Kingdom.
